The adapter block (D-28, FR-33.4.5). Every field but `applied` is null when nothing is
applied. Forbids extra fields, so a status dict that grew a key fails validation instead of
reaching the unauthenticated status routes.

cuda_memory.description: Allocated and reserved MiB per card in this process (addendum D-47). With nothing resident, allocated memory well above zero was never released by a consumer (handles never rebuilt, or a trainer that died or exited holding them); only a restart returns it. Null when CUDA is not available.

exports_since_start.description: Handle exports (attaches) this process has made since it started.

held_requests.description: Interactive requests waiting while quiesced; null while serving.

config.description: The served model's architecture config exactly as loaded (its own JSON form, every attribute stated), so a trainer rebuilds the graph around the handles from the config this process instantiated. Null when the model has no Hugging Face config. Additive (suite decision D39, 2026-10-17).
config.title: Config
